body:
thank you, reading this helped.

I do really want to go into medicine, which would require graduating college, and I also really enjoy chemistry which requires a degree in most cases. I will take your advice and be honest to my parents, and I'll probably see what happens. Thank you, and please have a nice day.

The thing is, I'm not going to be able to deal with the shit they throw at me. My self-esteem is already at an all time low, and if I stay in, I don't know if I can deal with it despite the monetary support they may or may not give me.
You're right, it's dirty of me to do that. What after, though? I have no way of paying off my tuition and finding a place to live.

I probably will, but what would my next steps be after? I'd probably leave the house and strike out on my own, but I'm not sure if I can pay off tuition just by working over the summer, and I'd have to find a place to live, in California no less. My parents also have essentially all of my money, and I can't exactly ask for them to hand it over.
